notice: This profile is the Korg ARP 2600 M reissue, not the original pre-MIDI ARP 2600 or the full-size ARP 2600 FS. Synthesis sections follow the 2600 FS inventory and the M owner's manual pp. 6-16; the M omits the ARP 3620 keyboard and adds a MOD CV jack driven by CC1. Per the MIDI chart it receives notes (velocity ignored), pitch bend, CC1 modulation, CC5 portamento time, CC65 portamento, CC69 Hold 2 (interval latch), CC120 and CC121, and transmits nothing but SysEx device inquiry responses. Received notes drive KBD CV-1 (lower) and KBD CV-2 (upper). Voice assign and trigger modes are set by holding MANUAL START at power-on. Set the MIDI channel with side-panel MODE SWITCH 1-4 (factory channel 1); switch 5 sets auto power-off. The USB MIDI CONTROLLER port accepts a USB MIDI controller without a hub. Patch jacks are analog, not MIDI. Consult Korg driver requirements for USB. Select the profile manually for a DIN interface.
